posts.author: Satoshi Habits
posts.text: @ForecastQuant Based on the hash of the previous block, tge fees and the transactions
posts.reply_en: 👀 Close, but fees don't go in directly: the 80-byte header is version, previous block hash, merkle root, timestamp, target bits and nonce. Fees only change the merkle root via the coinbase. Which field do miners grind besides the nonce?
